name: souroldgeezer
description: Claude Code plugins by Sour Old Geezer: skills for code auditing, review, and development workflows, with matching Claude Code subagents.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-audit
plugins.description: Rubric-driven audits for DevSecOps posture, test quality, IP hygiene, and duplication/waste (Lean), with per-stack extensions and evidence-focused findings.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-design
plugins.description: Reference-driven design skills for sustainable software, web frontend application design, HTTP API endpoints and architecture, and infrastructure. Covers code/module/script boundaries, software design principles/patterns, API portfolio cohesion, fragmentation, sprawl, consolidation, overlap, and consumer chattiness, plus app routes/screens/component architecture/state/data/rendering/responsive/accessibility/performance, with shared Build, Extract, Review, and Lookup workflows. Supports modern .NET™, Java™, Rust®, TypeScript, shell, Python®, React, Next.js, Blazor™ WebAssembly, Azure® Functions™, Node.js®, hosted Next.js™, Python® ASGI/WSGI, Azure® Cosmos DB™, Azure® Blob Storage™, Azure, Terraform™, and Bicep™ extensions.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-architecture
plugins.description: Reference-driven ArchiMate® and UML® architecture/design modeling for enterprise, solution, and application architectures. Covers dediren package source, SVG render evidence, a shareable self-contained HTML gallery, optional OEF/XMI export, cross-notation handoff links, build/extract/review/render/validate/lookup, drift detection, .NET™ / Java™ / Bicep™ / workflow lifting, per-view readiness, and maintained architecture evidence.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-policy
plugins.description: Passive policy skills for repo-initialized git workflow, release versioning, test-driven development, and plan-first brainstorming before new build work, plus runtime-appropriate delegation guidance for approved plan steps.

plugins.name: souroldgeezer-ops
plugins.description: Operations skills for issue, work-item, and pull-request lifecycle handling, with provider-agnostic cores and provider-specific extensions.
